title: Yellow Springy Greek Vegetable Pilaf
description: A resinous and springy post-workout Greek dish featuring katsuramuki-cut vegetables and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, made with self-raising flour. It is a healthy and flavorful meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the self-raising flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the katsuramuki-cut zucchini and carrots to the skillet and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced yellow bell pepper to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir the cooked vegetables into the bowl with the flour mixture.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the vegetable mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the pilaf from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
